title: Chapitre 20 : Subjonctif : Importance
description: Utiliser des expressions impersonnelles comme 'Il est important que'.

sentences.french: Il est important que tu parles.
sentences.english: It is important that you speak.
I must eat / It is necessary that I eat.

sentences.french: Il est nécessaire que nous soyons là.
sentences.english: It is necessary that we are there.
It is possible that he comes.

sentences.french: Il vaut mieux que vous partiez.
sentences.english: It is better that you leave.

il faut que.mnemonic: Think 'fault' — it's a fault if you don't do it.
il faut que.explanation: One of the most common ways to express obligation. Uses the subjunctive.

vaut mieux.mnemonic: Think 'value' — it has more value to do this.
